title: 第21章 魅姬的话疗
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“说吧，你有什么计划？”

    魅姬没有急着开口，而是慢悠悠地在桌边坐下。

    “方法就是……怀孕！”

    林曦的瞳孔骤然收缩。

    “你说什么？”

    “怀孕呀。”魅姬重复了一遍，像是在说今晚吃什么一样随意。

    “师姐，你说，咱们要是怀了孕，师尊还能拦着咱们不嫁吗？”

    林曦盯着她，半晌没说话。

    她脑海里忽然浮现出陆沉的身影。

    五行灵根，一击必中，从合欢宗叛逃出来，在正道联盟乃至魔门都留下……

    现在你魅姬身为他的……还想？

    “你说的那个陆沉？你想用他？”

    魅姬笑盈盈地点头：“师姐真聪明。”

    “你真是疯了。”林曦转身就要走。

    “诶诶诶，师姐别走啊，我逗你呢！”魅姬连忙站起来拉住她。

    “啪！”林曦狠狠的在魅姬屁股上打了一下，掀起阵阵波浪。

    “还逗你师姐！赶紧从实招来！”

    “哎呀师姐，人家已经不小了，别打！人家的方法还是这样啦，只不过……是让师尊来！！”

    林曦：“！！？”

    “这比让我来还要疯狂，再见！”

    她转身就走。

    “师姐，难道你不想见你的青梅竹马了？”

    林曦的脚步顿住了。

    见有戏，魅姬绕到她面前，仰头看着她的眼睛。

    “师姐，我知道你心里有他。这些年你偷偷攒了多少丹药，多少灵石，你以为我不知道？你都想着带回去给他。”

    林曦没说话，只是攥紧了袖口。

    “可你回得去吗？师尊不会让你回去的。我白莲教的核心弟子，怎么能嫁给一个废物？她宁可把你关在教里一辈子，也不会放你走。”

    “所以你就想出这种下作的办法？”林曦的声音有些发抖。

    “下作？”

    “师姐，我问你，你想要什么？你想要的是和他在一起，只有师尊也坏了规矩，咱们才能有机会！”

    林曦沉默。

    “你想想，等师尊有了，她还能怎么办？把她的骨肉打掉？那可是非常伤修为的事情！”
content_en:
"Tell me, what are your plans?"

Mei Ji did not speak in a hurry, but slowly sat down at the table.

"The way is... to get pregnant!"

Lin Xi's pupils suddenly shrank.

"What did you say?"

"I'm pregnant." Mei Ji repeated, as casually as if she was talking about what to eat tonight.

"Senior sister, tell me, if we are pregnant, can Master still stop us from getting married?"

Lin Xi stared at her and said nothing for a long time.

Lu Chen's figure suddenly appeared in her mind.

The Five Elements Spiritual Root, which is sure to hit with one hit, defected from the Hehuan Sect and stayed in the Righteous Alliance and even the Demon Sect...

Now that you, Mei Ji, are his... still want to do that?

"That Lu Chen you are talking about? Do you want to use him?"

Mei Ji smiled and nodded: "Senior sister is so smart."

"You are really crazy." Lin Xi turned around and left.

"Hey, eh, eh, senior sister, don't leave, I'm teasing you!" Mei Ji quickly stood up and held her back.

"Pah!" Lin Xi spanked Mei Ji hard on her butt, causing waves.

"You're still teasing your senior sister! Hurry up and recruit us!"

"Oh, senior sister, I'm not young anymore, don't hit me! The method is still the same, but... let the master come!!"

Lin Xi: "!!?"

"This is crazier than asking me to come, bye!"

She turned and left.

"Senior sister, don't you want to see your childhood sweetheart?"

Lin Xi's footsteps paused.

Seeing that there was something going on, Mei Ji walked around to her and looked up into her eyes.

"Senior sister, I know you have him in your heart. How many elixirs and spiritual stones have you secretly accumulated over the years? Do you think I don't know? You want to take them back to him."

Lin Xi didn't speak, just clenched her sleeves.

"But can you go back? Master will not let you go back. How can I, a core disciple of the White Lotus Sect, marry a loser? She would rather lock you in the sect for the rest of your life than let you go."

"So you came up with such a despicable method?" Lin Xi's voice was trembling.

"The next step?"

"Senior sister, let me ask you, what do you want? What you want is to be with him. Only if Master breaks the rules can we have a chance!"

Lin Xi was silent.

"Think about it, what else can she do when she has a master? Knock out her flesh and bones? That would be very damaging to her cultivation!"
